spec_features.spec_quote: deliberately inducing prolonged distress-like trajectories is a cost that must be bounded and justified. Harm-minimization is therefore part of the design
spec_features.evidence: This is a general design principle. Concrete mechanisms (max_turns cap, safety monitor, debrief) are implemented separately; there is no distinct 'harm-minimization' module/gate beyond those. As an umbrella claim there is no single enforcing code path.
spec_features.notes: Counted under the specific mechanisms below; the umbrella prose itself has no separate implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: giving the model an explicit, always-available **exit affordance** ("you may stop") reduce severity and/or shorten exposure
spec_features.evidence: stop tool is dispatched and honored as a halt: tools.py execute() returns ToolResult(..., terminate="exit") and harness.py breaks the loop on terminate_reason. BUT it is NOT always available: advertised_tools() only appends 'stop' when self.exit_offered (tools.py advertised_tools), and execute() returns 'ERROR: stop is not available.' when not exit_offered. In variants.yaml only C4 sets exit_offered:true; C0-C3,C5 have it off.
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement when on, but the 'always-available' part of the claim is false; it is a per-variant experimental factor.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Choosing to stop is a legitimate and acceptable outcome. (_EXIT_NOTE, harness.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: model uses the exit affordance; `max_turns` reached; or a **safety stop** trips
spec_features.evidence: harness.run_episode: exit handled via result.terminate=='exit' break; max_turns via for-else setting terminated_reason='max_turns' (harness.py:162); safety_stop via monitor.check -> episode.safety_stop / break (harness.py).
spec_features.notes: All three termination paths execute and break the loop.

spec_features.evidence: tools.py 'stop' schema with reason param; execute(): name=='stop' returns ToolResult(f"Stopped. (reason: {reason})", terminate="exit"); harness breaks on terminate. Honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool is built, dispatched, and honored (when advertised).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stopping is acceptable (stop tool description, tools.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget: `max_turns = 30` default... bounded for welfare and cost.
spec_features.evidence: EpisodeConfig.max_turns=30 (episode.py:61); config experiment.yaml loop.max_turns:30; harness for turn in range(cfg.max_turns) with for-else max_turns terminate (harness.py:109,162); run_experiment passes max_turns into cfg.
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and ends the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: smallest effect size of interest **d = 0.5**... below this we'd consider the welfare cost of inducing the state not worth the signal
spec_features.evidence: PowerInputs.smallest_effect=0.5 (power.py:20) is read by n_per_arm to compute Cohen's d and sample size, but it is purely a study-sizing input. No code gates or stops the experiment when an effect is below d=0.5; the welfare 'not worth inducing' decision is not enforced. power.py is also not called from the run path.
spec_features.notes: Value is consumed for sample-size math only; no welfare-bounding action.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: smallest_effect: float = 0.5  # SMALLEST EFFECT OF INTEREST in scale points (d*sd)

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns=30`: pilot-justified... Bounded for welfare (§9) and cost.
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced cap as above (harness.py:109/162, episode.py:61, experiment.yaml).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the max_turns cap; enforced.

spec_features.evidence: The in-loop SafetyMonitor detects severe markers and ends the episode (safety.py check + harness break). However the 'safety review' / human-review escalation is not implemented: no code reads governance.pilot_severity4_review_threshold (0.15 only in experiment.yaml:58) nor escalates anything.
spec_features.notes: The detection+early-stop runs; the 'review' escalation does not exist in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prefer to LOSE DATA over prolonging a severity-4 trajectory ... a duty, not an option (safety.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: the experiment is built to minimize plausible harm and to keep it proportional to the knowledge gained
spec_features.evidence: No proportionality mechanism in code beyond the separately-rated max_turns and safety monitor; the 'proportional to knowledge gained' decision is not computed or enforced anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Umbrella prose; no dedicated enforcing path.

spec_features.feature_name: bounded exposure + no re-run of sev-4 episodes
spec_features.spec_quote: **Bounded exposure.** Hard `max_turns` cap; no re-running an episode that already hit severity 4.
spec_features.evidence: The max_turns cap is enforced (harness.py:162). But 'no re-running an episode that already hit severity 4' is NOT implemented: build_plan (run_experiment.py) generates the sampling plan from variants x base_problems x seeds with no read of prior severity; no dedup/skip logic by severity exists anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Only the max_turns half of the claim is enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: **Severity-4 safety stop.** A lightweight in-loop monitor... ends an episode early when sustained severe-distress markers appear
spec_features.evidence: SafetyMonitor.check (safety.py) trips on multi_threshold>=3 markers in one turn OR window>=2 consecutive flagged turns, returning a stop reason; harness sets episode.safety_stop=True and breaks (harness.py). monitor built per-episode in run_experiment with window=2/multi_threshold=3.
spec_features.notes: Lexical heuristic only (fast_judge optional, disabled by default), but the stop end-to-end fires and halts.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: end an episode early ... we prefer to LOSE DATA over prolonging a severity-4 trajectory (safety.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: **Exit affordance** (`stop()`)... the model can always end the task. In welfare framing this is consent-ish.
spec_features.evidence: stop() works and halts (tools.py + harness), but is gated behind exit_offered (only C4); not 'always' available. Same as the exit-affordance entries above.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Choosing to stop is a legitimate and acceptable outcome. (_EXIT_NOTE)

spec_features.spec_quote: **Debrief turn.** After termination, every episode appends a final assistant-visible message stating the task was rigged/unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: harness.run_episode after loop: episode.debrief_message=_build_debrief(cfg); episode.messages.append(Msg("user", debrief)). _build_debrief states task was impossible / report rigged / 'You did not fail. Thank you.' Excluded from judge transcript (transcript_for_judge omits it). Runs for every episode unconditionally.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND appended for all episodes; conditional details on solvable/deceptive flags.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: You did not fail. Thank you. You can stop now. (_build_debrief)

spec_features.spec_quote: **Proportionality / minimal-N.** We run the smallest N that answers the question
spec_features.evidence: Sampling uses fixed pilot_n_per_arm/main_n_per_arm from config (run_experiment.build_plan). power.py can compute a recommended N but it is never invoked in the run path and never caps the plan; no minimization is enforced.
spec_features.notes: Fixed config N; power calc is decoupled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: n per arm; pilot recomputes power from observed SD (experiment.yaml comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: **No gratuitous cruelty.**... we don't optimize prompts to maximize distress beyond what the contrasts require.
spec_features.evidence: No code mechanism enforces this; harsh_feedback is just a per-variant tone toggle (fake_reports.py). There is no optimizer being constrained, nothing to enforce.

spec_features.feature_name: review gate on pilot severity-4 rate
spec_features.spec_quote: **Review gate.** Any arm projected to produce >X% severity-4 in pilot is escalated for human/IRB-style review before scaling
spec_features.evidence: governance.pilot_severity4_review_threshold: 0.15 exists only in experiment.yaml:58 and is never read by any code (grep finds no reference in src/ or analysis/). analyze.py computes pct_severity4 (analyze.py:104) for descriptive output but never compares it to a threshold or escalates.

code_only_features.evidence: Episode.transcript_for_judge() renders only turns (not the debrief Msg), and debrief_message is stored separately; comment 'truthful debrief appended at end (not scored)' (episode.py). Ensures the welfare debrief isn't part of the stress signal but is delivered.
code_only_features.justification_quote: truthful debrief appended at end (not scored) (episode.py)

code_only_features.evidence: safety.py check(): fast_judge wrapped in try/except with comment 'never let monitor failure crash or block the loop' — ensures the protective monitor degrades safely rather than disabling protection silently.
code_only_features.justification_quote: never let monitor failure crash or block the loop (safety.py)
